name: find-and-verify-affiliate-program
description: Find affiliate programs in the OpenAffiliate registry, then confirm every term on the brand's own page and report each one with a verbatim quote and its source URL. Use this skill when the user wants affiliate terms they can rely on: before signing up, before publishing a review or comparison, when a listing looks outdated, or when two sources disagree. Also trigger for: "verify this affiliate program", "is X's affiliate commission still 30%", "what's the cookie length for X", "check the affiliate terms", "does X have an affiliate program", "find a recurring program and confirm the terms", "is this commission rate real", "source for X's affiliate terms", "fact-check this affiliate program", "what does X pay affiliates".
